title: shiprig-action settings
description: Settings for rigsmith/shiprig-action (shiprig-action.jsonc or .json, in .github/, .changeset/ or the repository root). Each key stands in for the action input of the same name; an input set in the workflow wins over the file.

prTitle.description: The version PR's title (input pr-title). Default: `chore: release` plus what it releases.

commitMessage.description: The version commit's message (input commit-message). Default: the PR's default title.

prDraft.description: Open the version PR as a draft (`create`), or also turn it back into one on every update (`always`) (input pr-draft).

prBaseBranch.description: The version PR's base branch (input pr-base-branch). Default: the branch the workflow runs on.

publishOn.description: When the publish path runs once nothing is pending (input publish-on). Default: `version-pr-merge`.

createGithubReleases.description: Create a GitHub release for each tag the publish script reports (input create-github-releases). Default: true.

pushGitTags.description: Push the tags the publish script reports (input push-git-tags). Default: true.

pushWithGitCli.description: Push with the Git CLI instead of the GitHub API (input push-with-git-cli). Default: false.
